final: WITH account_town AS (SELECT ft.account_id, c.town_city, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM Financial_Transactions AS ft JOIN Accounts AS a ON a.account_id = ft.account_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = a.customer_id GROUP BY ft.account_id, c.town_city), town_totals AS (SELECT town_city, SUM(transaction_count) AS town_total FROM account_town GROUP BY town_city), matched AS (SELECT at.account_id, at.town_city, at.transaction_count, 1.0 * at.transaction_count / tt.town_total AS town_share FROM account_town AS at JOIN town_totals AS tt ON at.town_city COLLATE BINARY = tt.town_city), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(transaction_count) AS avg_count FROM matched) SELECT m.account_id, m.town_city, m.transaction_count, m.town_share, 1.0 * m.transaction_count / av.avg_count AS average_ratio FROM matched AS m CROSS JOIN average_count AS av WHERE av.avg_count IS NOT NULL ORDER BY average_ratio DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
